components.explanation: The hurt tint: shaders/hurt_tint.gdshader (canvas_item, the colour line at line 7), the presentation-only driver features/player/hurt_tint_driver.gd that maps Player.invulnerable to intensity every frame, the ShaderMaterial and HurtTint node wired into player.tscn, and its test.

The frosted rock: shaders/rock_frost.gdshader (albedo as colour, normal and roughness maps as data; the roughness map decides where frost settles), the dry and frosted materials, the Poly Haven Rock 01 textures with explicit import settings, and material_compare.tscn, where both rocks carry the material as a surface 0 override.

The hint experiment: one 3x1 grey PNG (written by tools/write_hint_png.gd, imported lossless) sampled with and without source_color by shaders/hint_experiment.gdshader on two unshaded quads in hint_experiment.tscn.
shaders/standard_generated.gdshader: the shader Godot 4.7.2 writes for a StandardMaterial3D, converted by the author in the editor; used only for comparison.

The checks around both shaders: test_hurt_tint.gd, test_materials.gd and the MATERIALS.md audit it pins, the curl check (normal_map_check.gd) and its calibration, the surface inspection, and the F9-F12 capture scenes that produced every image in the film.
